q-0440.answer:
Surah Yaseen (36) — Yaseen · 83 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• Until a time that is known to Allah, may He be glorified and exalted.
• The like of mankind. So, He will re-create them as He created them in the first place.
• He only needs to command a thing once; it does not need to be repeated or confirmed.

q-0549.answer:
Surah Al-Munaafiqoon (63) — The Hypocrites · 11 ayahs · Medinan

Main teachings:
• He has decreed them to be hypocrites because they reverted from faith to disbelief and exchanged guidance for misguidance.
• The hypocrites shield themselves from Muslims when they falsely and sinfully swear to be what they are not in reality.
• When the hypocrites come to you, they announce this statement and pretend to believe in it.

q-0624.answer:
Surah Al-Infitaar (82) — The Cleaving · 19 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• What will happen on the Day of Judgement
• No one will be able to benefit anyone else, or help him out of that which he will be in, unless Allah gives permission to whomever He wishes and is pleased with.
• Mankind should not forget about Allah
• The Cause of Deception and alerting to the Fact that Angels record the Deeds of the Children of Adam
• You are only compelled to oppose the Most Generous and meet Him with disobedience, by your rejection in your hearts of the Hereafter, the recompense and the reckoning.

q-0651.answer:
Surah Al-Ghaashiya (88) — The Overwhelming · 26 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• They did many deeds and became weary in their performance, yet they will be cast into a blazing Fire on the Day of Judgement.
• They will not hear in the Paradise that they will be in, any foolish word.
• Charged with Delivering the Message
• Flowing freely. This is mentioned with the intent of emphasizing affirmation.
• The Threat for Whoever Turns Away from the Truth

Surah At-Takaathur (102) — Competition · 8 ayahs · Meccan

Main teachings:
• The Result of Loving the World and Heedlessness of the Hereafter
• If you knew with true knowledge, you would not be diverted by rivalry for wealth away from seeking the abode of the Hereafter until you reach the graves.
• On that Day you all will be questioned concerning your gratitude towards the favors that Allah blessed you with, such as health, safety, sustenance and other things.

Surah Al-Mumtahana (60) — She that is to be examined · 13 ayahs · Medinan

Main teachings:
• Your only fault is that you believed in Allah, Lord of all that exists.
• You cannot follow Ibrahim's example as proof in the case mentioned here, as being allowed to ask Allah to forgive those who died on Shirk.
• Unless, and until, you worship Allah alone without partners and disbelieve in the idols and rivals that you worship besides Him.
